title: Speak a mortal's name
prompt: Painterly dark-fantasy illustration in the style of a cinematic tabletop RPG book spread: wide 16:9 landscape composition, dramatic lighting with warm ember-orange highlights against cold ice-blue shadows, rich texture, a clear focal point. No text, no captions, no speech bubbles, no logos, no watermark. Scene: a volcanic sanctum of black basalt. On a dais stand the colossal ancient Scales of Judgement, bronze and smouldering like still-hot metal. Runes around their base blaze with fiery light as D.E.R.E.K. drifts a hand theatrically across them, while Ulrick stares up at the Scales in awe. D.E.R.E.K. (Chadron): a humanoid golden construct with a smooth metal face, a single large glowing blue eye and full red lips, in hooded red-and-orange robes with clockwork and clock-face motifs.
